records.title: Data Management
records.text: TBANLT 411 Data Management (5) Focuses on the skills and knowledge necessary to acquire, model, store, transform, manage and represent data, and how to convert that data to information for desired outcomes in context of small and big data. Course overlaps with: T INST 311 and CSS 475. Recommended: proficiency in Excel/spreadsheets.

records.title: Programming for Data Analytics
records.text: TBANLT 433 Programming for Data Analytics (5) Provides an introduction to R programming and Python for addressing business analytics problems. Fundamentals of R and Python, data structures and their operators are covered. Use of packages and libraries for analytics, visualization, and data structure manipulation is emphasized. Business and predictive analytics topics will be introduced with programming solutions. Recommended: proficiency in Excel/spreadsheets.

records.title: Decision Modeling
records.text: TBANLT 450 Decision Modeling (5) Introduces the development, implementation, and utilization of business models for managerial decision making. It covers formulation of models and interpretation of the information a model produces. Some of the deterministic optimization techniques (e.g. linear/nonlinear models) and probabilistic decision-making techniques (e.g. network models and decision trees) are covered. Course overlaps with: QMETH 450. Prerequisite: either TMATH 110, T BGEN 200, QMETH 201, STAT 220, STAT 221/CS&SS 221/SOC 221, or STAT 311.

records.title: Predictive Analytics
records.text: TBANLT 460 Predictive Analytics (5) Covers popular methods in predictive analytics including association rules, classification, regression trees, logistic regression and introduces cutting edge interactive data-visualization tools and data reduction techniques. Prerequisite: either TMATH 110, TMATH 390, QMETH 201, Q SCI 381, STAT 220, STAT 221/CSSS 221/SOC 221, STAT 311, or T BUS 301.

records.title: Social Media Management and Analytics
records.header: TBANLT 480 Social Media Management and Analytics (5)
records.text: TBANLT 480 Social Media Management and Analytics (5) Focuses on the primary concepts, methods, tools and solutions to develop a social media strategy, and to collect, process and transform social media data into information processes, knowledge, actionable decisions and processes. Covers how organizations make use of social media as a strategy to gain a competitive advantage. Course overlaps with: MKTG 466. Recommended: proficiency in Excel/spreadsheets.

records.title: Business Intelligence
records.text: TBANLT 485 Business Intelligence (5) Focuses on foundations of data and analytics. Explains concepts by examining innovative uses of information systems, data, and analytics to support managerial decision-making. Explores how to collect, store, manage, and convert data into information, knowledge, and actionable insights. Course overlaps with: I S 451 and B BUS 375. Recommended: proficiency in Excel/spreadsheets; and either TBANLT 411, or familiarity with data and database management concepts.

records.title: Special Topics in Business Data Analytics
records.header: TBANLT 490 Special Topics in Business Data Analytics (1-5, max. 5)
records.text: TBANLT 490 Special Topics in Business Data Analytics (1-5, max. 5) Study and research on topics of current concern to faculty and students in the area of business data analytics. Only offered when allowed by faculty availability and sufficient student interest. Seminar content to be announced in advance of scheduled offerings.
